description: Hi! I am an Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AIML) student with a keen interest in technology, programming, AI and space exploration. I enjoy learning new technologies, and exploring creative ideas. I am excited to participate in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to gain practical experience, improve my technical skills and collaborate with others. I look forward to contributing my knowledge and learning new things while building an innovative Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.
summary: The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive space exploration experience designed for students to learn about space, NASA missions, and astronaut activities. It allows users to experience astronaut training, complete space challenges, explore planets, and understand the basics of spacecraft and space missions in a fun and educational way.
details: The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an educational space-learning program designed to help students understand the life and activities of astronauts. It provides an opportunity to learn how astronauts prepare for space missions and perform different tasks in space. Through this program, students can explore basic space science, astronaut training, spacecraft operations, and space exploration. It helps develop problem-solving skills, scientific thinking, creativity, and teamwork.
